en.t: Please take this and buy some persimmons to try.

units.source_text: 从二楼扔下去，有点失礼了。”

en.t: It was rather rude of me to toss it down from the second floor.

units.source_text: 我说罢，把一小包钱扔了下去。

en.t: After saying that, I tossed down a small packet of money.

units.source_text: 汉子谢绝了，想要走过去，但纸包却已落在庭院里，他又回头捡了起来。

en.t: The man declined and tried to walk on, but the paper packet had already fallen into the garden, so he turned back and picked it up.
